# hivelocity_dns_record_ptr (Data Source)

Looks up the PTR (reverse DNS) record of one of your IP addresses, typically by `address`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_dns_record_ptr" "web" {
  filter {
    name   = "address"
    values = ["66.165.231.122"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address of the record.
- `disabled` (Boolean) True when the record is disabled.
- `domain_id` (Number) ID of the reverse zone.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Host name the address resolves to.
- `record_id` (Number) Unique ID of the record.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live, in seconds.
- `type` (String) Record type.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
